subsystem: Apple Video Encoder 2 (AVE2) XNU Kernel Boundary

roles: Manages AVE2 power domains and clock meshes
Loads and authenticates AppleAVE2FW_H18.im4p firmware image
Configures dart-ave IOMMU memory apertures for YUV surfaces
Handles fatal hardware interrupts and watchdog timeouts
Hardware ProRes 422 and 4444 frame encode dispatch

AppleAVE2UserClient.client_access: Restricted to VideoToolbox and authorized system daemons (mediaserverd)

AVE_UCCmd_Open.name: IO_Open
AVE_UCCmd_Open.description: Establishes video encoder session context, allocates DPB slots, and reserves command queue space

AVE_UCCmd_Close.name: IO_Close
AVE_UCCmd_Close.description: Terminates active encoder session, unmaps IOSurface descriptors, and releases hardware state

AVE_UCCmd_Config.name: IO_Config
AVE_UCCmd_Config.description: Registers Mach async port for frame completion callbacks and configures bitrate/framerate

AVE_UCCmd_Prepare.name: IO_Prepare
AVE_UCCmd_Prepare.description: Validates and pins IOSurface memory, maps physical pages into dart-ave IOMMU

AVE_UCCmd_Start.name: IO_Start
AVE_UCCmd_Start.description: Starts hardware encoding pipeline for the configured stream

AVE_UCCmd_Stop.name: IO_Stop
AVE_UCCmd_Stop.description: Stops stream encoding and drains in-flight hardware DMA channels

AVE_UCCmd_Process.name: IO_Process
AVE_UCCmd_Process.description: Submits single frame encode request into hardware command ring and rings doorbell

AVE_UCCmd_Complete.name: IO_Complete
AVE_UCCmd_Complete.description: Asynchronous callback dispatched by kernel upon coprocessor completion doorbell

AVE_UCCmd_Flush.name: IO_Flush
AVE_UCCmd_Flush.description: Flushes all buffered frames across pipeline stages to output bitstream

AVE_UCCmd_Reset.name: IO_Reset
AVE_UCCmd_Reset.description: Resets hardware codec pipe after recovery from DMA or bus parity timeout
